12.name: Sur-ving Drama
12.overview: Lisa Vanderpump shepherds a group of bartenders and servers through life at SUR. In the season premiere, Natalie gets a frosty reception from Kim and Demy when she returns from a weeklong suspension. Shayne flaunts another girl in Natalie’s face. Marcus gets caught teaching Jason how to sneak drinks at work, unleashing repercussions.

12.name: Manifest and Chill
12.overview: Audrey throws a glamorous 22nd birthday party where she cozies up to Chris, the new bartender. Lisa confronts Marcus. Venus attempts to broker peace between Natalie and Kim, but things go south when Marcus gets involved.

12.name: Crash Out Queens
12.overview: Lisa organizes the annual SUR photoshoot where new hostess Angelica catches Jason’s eye. Venus confronts Marcus and Kim about their on-again/off-again relationship. Natalie and Shayne go on their first date, but things go awry at Angelica’s pool party.

12.name: Pour Decisions
12.overview: Kim plans a girls' night that descends into madness when Natalie refuses to ignore their problems. Chris helps Audrey move into her new apartment. Jason attempts to reconnect with Angelica after an awkward situation.

12.name: Seeing Red (Flags)
12.overview: Lisa gives Marcus an opportunity to DJ a premiere party at SUR. Venus attempts to mend his friendship with Kim. Shayne dates two girls at the same time. Audrey tells Angelica about Chris and Jason's other job, which leads to explosive consequences.

12.name: Pump Fiction
12.overview: Lisa enlists the SURvers to work a photoshoot at TomTom, but things go downhill when Angelica reveals what was found in Jason’s shower. Demy decides to move on from her friendship with Natalie. Shayne celebrates the premiere of his short film.

12.name: Paso Aggressive
12.overview: Lisa throws an intimate 20th anniversary party to celebrate the founding of SUR. Angelica and Shayne grow closer, despite Shayne's transparent feelings about monogamy. The group travels to Paso Robles to work at Lisa’s Women in Wine event, but Angelica spills another secret that threatens to upend the group.

12.name: Speakerphone Suckerpunch
12.overview: In Paso Robles, Audrey overhears a phone call that makes her rethink her relationship with Chris. Shayne convinces Angelica to keep quiet about Chris and Jason’s video. On a wild night out, the group finds themselves in a number of romantic entanglements.

12.name: Rosé All Day
12.overview: The group rents a party bus for a day of wine tasting in the vineyards. Angelica exposes Chris and Jason's video to the group, causing Shayne to have second thoughts about his relationship with her.

12.name: Threesome's a Crowd
12.overview: Back in Los Angeles, Audrey finds herself second-guessing her relationship with Chris. Venus opens up to Lisa. Jason continues to pursue Natalie. Marcus and Kim make a surprising decision about their future.

12.name: Back Alley Betrayals
12.overview: Angelica returns to work with a new look and a new relationship. Chris has second thoughts about getting back together with Audrey. Shayne makes another move on Natalie. Audrey roasts her friends during a stand-up comedy performance, but one particular member of the group becomes the butt of the joke.

12.name: Pride and Joy
12.overview: Angelica finally moves out of the apartment she shared with her ex. Chris plans a romantic gesture for Audrey. Venus hosts SUR's annual Pride celebration. Angelica confronts Audrey for the jokes made at her comedy show.

12.name: Reunion (1)
12.overview: Audrey and Angelica clash over a recent feud. Venus opens up about his last relationship. Chris responds to cheating allegations.

12.name: Reunion (2)
12.overview: In the dramatic conclusion to the season, Chris and Jason open up about their controversial video. Shayne and Natalie reveal surprising developments in their relationship. Angelica must defend her new boyfriend to the group.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Reunion (2)
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: In the dramatic conclusion to the season, Chris and Jason open up about their controversial video. Shayne and Natalie reveal surprising developments in their relationship. Angelica must defend her new boyfriend to the group.

overview: Follow the passionate, volatile and hot-and-bothered-staff at Lisa Vanderpump’s West Hollywood mainstay SUR. Lisa balances her motherly instincts and shrewd business sense to keep control over this wild group of employees as they pursue their dreams and each other while working at her “Sexy, Unique Restaurant.”

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: This season on Vanderpump Rules, the deep-rooted, dynamic group of friends, frenemies and lovers that have been working for Lisa Vanderpump at SUR for years are shaking things up — from Pump-tinis to chaos.
